traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified: - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags, with explicit passing tests for each scenario. - The parser terminates @story/@req values at any non-traceability @tag boundary using isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine and the new branch in processCommentLine. - Continuations only occur on lines that do not start with an @tag, preserving intended multiline behavior while preventing JSDoc tags from being concatenated into values. - The original bug scenario from Issue #3 (REQ-OPTIMIZATION with following @param/@returns) is now a passing valid test, demonstrating that false positives are eliminated. - Existing annotation behavior remains intact, as shown by the full suite of pre-existing tests still passing. - Documentation has been updated with a clear “JSDoc coexistence” section and examples.
Given the concrete code changes, targeted tests tied to this story, and successful test run, Story 022 is fully implemented and passes its acceptance criteria.
